import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',prog)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def blank(n): return [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
def add_line(g,color,r0,r1,d):
    # d = c-r; include in-bounds cells for this diagonal
    n=len(g)
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        c=r+d
        if 0<=c<n:
            if g[r][c] not in (0,color):
                raise ValueError(('collision',r,c,g[r][c],color))
            g[r][c]=color
# Pair 1: seven full-width row clues.
g1=blank(13)
for r,col in [(1,2),(2,1),(4,8),(6,9),(7,9),(10,4),(12,5)]: g1[r]=[col]*13
m1=[9,2,1,4,8,5,9]
e1=[[m1[r%7]]*13 for r in range(13)]
# Pair 2: diagonal clue tracks, with period 5.
g2=blank(16)
for col,r0,r1,d in [(3,0,14,1),(3,0,3,12),(8,0,12,3),(4,11,15,-11),(5,15,15,-15)]: add_line(g2,col,r0,r1,d)
m2=[5,3,3,8,4]
e2=[[m2[(c-r)%5] for c in range(16)] for r in range(16)]
# Pair 3: period-8 diagonal clue tracks.
g3=blank(26)
for col,r0,r1,d in [(8,0,18,0),(3,0,22,3),(2,0,20,5),(6,4,25,-4),(4,18,25,-18),(1,0,7,18),(1,7,25,-7),(1,9,25,-9)]: add_line(g3,col,r0,r1,d)
m3=[8,1,1,3,6,2,4,1]
e3=[[m3[(c-r)%8] for c in range(26)] for r in range(26)]
# Pair 4: period-6 diagonal clue tracks.
g4=blank(14)
for col,r0,r1,d in [(4,0,12,1),(4,0,2,11),(1,0,11,2),(7,0,7,6),(7,9,13,-9),(3,2,13,-2)]: add_line(g4,col,r0,r1,d)
m4=[7,4,1,7,3,4]
e4=[[m4[(c-r)%6] for c in range(14)] for r in range(14)]
tests=[(g1,e1),(g2,e2),(g3,e3),(g4,e4)]
for i,(gi,ei) in enumerate(tests,1):
    out=mod.transform(gi)
    diffs=[(r,c,out[r][c],ei[r][c]) for r in range(len(ei)) for c in range(len(ei[0])) if out[r][c]!=ei[r][c]]
    print('demo',i,'pass=',not diffs,'diffs=',diffs[:3])
